title: A three-element array of maps under maxArraySize=4 round-trips exactly
rationale: The below-the-cliff control for maxArraySize, and proof that array-of-maps CAN round-trip, which stops the array DEFECT fixtures from being dismissed as "arrays just do not work".
catchesBugClass: An over-eager maxArraySize comparison and any regression in the columnar zip-back for uniform arrays of maps. The only shape in the family that exercises the happy path through reconstructArray.
cannotCatch: It is uniform and dense by construction, so it cannot catch padding misalignment, the last-value duplication branch, or the size>1 detection gate.

predicted.detail: limit = min(3,4) = 3, no truncation, all columns the same length so no padding occurs and the zip-back is exact.
